new_standard.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India — Formulations: Mahanarayana Taila Monograph
new_standard.scope: Specifies identity, purity and strength for classical Mahanarayana Taila medicated sesame oil formulation prepared per Bhaishajya Ratnavali for musculoskeletal disorders.
new_standard.materials: Sesamum indicum oil base, Dashamoola, Ashwagandha, Bala, Shatavari, milk and authentic herbs.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Refractive index at 40°C (1.464 to 1.470), weight per ml (0.915 to 0.930 g), saponification value (185 to 200), iodine value (100 to 115), acid value (max 3.5), heavy metals (lead <= 10 ppm, arsenic <= 3 ppm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Therapeutic consistency, skin penetrability, zero rancidity, microbial count compliant with AYUSH safety limits.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Thin layer chromatography fingerprinting per API Part II, rancidity test per IS 548.
new_standard.source: Pharmacopoeia Commission for Indian Medicine & Homoeopathy (PCIM&H) / Ministry of AYUSH

mapping.evidence_source: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (First Schedule); Ministry of AYUSH Good Manufacturing Practices (Schedule T)
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Mandatory compliance with Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India monographs for all classical Ayurvedic proprietary and generic formulations.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Mandatory statutory pharmacopoeial specification for Mahanarayan Taila in India.

new_standard.title: Medicinal Plant Products — Boswellia serrata Extract — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for standardized dry extracts of Boswellia serrata (Shallaki / Indian Frankincense) gum resin for anti-inflammatory and anti-arthritic formulations.
new_standard.materials: Purified hydro-alcoholic extract of oleo-gum-resin of Boswellia serrata Roxb.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total boswellic acids (min 65.0% by titrimetry / min 30.0% by HPLC), 11-keto-beta-boswellic acid AKBA content, loss on drying (max 5.0%), total ash (max 8.0%), heavy metals limits.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Standardized therapeutic potency, standardized solubility in alcohol, absence of solvent residues.
new_standard.testing_requirements: HPLC assay for AKBA per IS 17377 Annex B, heavy metals by ICP-MS per IS 16999.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards AYD 1 / PCIM&H

mapping.evidence_source: BIS AYD 1 Traditional Medicine Committee; Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India

new_standard.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India — Formulations: Chyawanprash Monograph
new_standard.scope: Specifies pharmacopoeial standards for classical Chyawanprash semi-solid confection (Avaleha) prepared with Amalaki (Emblica officinalis), ghee, sesame oil, honey, and herbal decoction.
new_standard.materials: Fresh mature Amla pulp, sugar/honey, Dashamoola, Ashtavarga, Pippali, cardamom.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total solids (min 65.0%), total sugars (55.0% to 65.0%), reducing sugars, ascorbic acid / Vitamin C (min 0.05%), pH of 10% solution (3.5 to 4.5), heavy metals limits.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Smooth spreadable semi-solid paste, sweet-sour-spicy taste; absence of mold, fermentation, or burnt flavor.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Total solids by refractometry, Vitamin C by 2,6-dichlorophenolindophenol titration, TLC fingerprinting.

new_standard.title: Medicinal Plant Products — Curcumin 95 Percent — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for 95% total curcuminoids extracted from rhizomes of Curcuma longa L. for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical use.
new_standard.materials: Purified crystalline extract of Curcuma longa rhizomes.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total curcuminoids content (min 95.0% by HPLC - curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, bisdemethoxycurcumin), melting point (182°C to 186°C), loss on drying (max 1.0%), residual solvents (ethanol <= 5000 ppm, ethyl acetate <= 5000 ppm, zero Class 1 solvents).
new_standard.performance_requirements: High antioxidant potency, crystalline yellow-orange powder, free from synthetic dyes or undeclared petroleum solvents.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Curcuminoids profile by HPLC per IS 17378 Annex B, residual solvents by Headspace GC per USP <467>.
new_standard.source: Bureau of Indian Standards AYD 1 / FSSAI Nutraceutical Standards

mapping.evidence_source: BIS AYD 1 Sectional Committee Specifications; FSSAI Health Supplements Regulations
mapping.evidence_excerpt: Clause 1: Prescribes requirements for standardized 95% curcuminoids extract from Curcuma longa.
mapping.applicability_explanation: Primary national standard for 95% standardized curcumin extract.

Homoeopathic Dilutions and Potencies.investigation_notes: Homoeopathic medicines, mother tinctures, and potentised dilutions (decimal/centesimal potencies) are exclusively regulated under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and the Homoeopathic Pharmacopoeia of India (HPI) administered by PCIM&H and Ministry of AYUSH. The Bureau of Indian Standards does not formulate technical standards for homoeopathic pharmaceutical preparations; hence no applicable BIS standard exists.

new_standard.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India — Minerals and Metals: Kasisa and Kasis Bhasma
new_standard.scope: Specifies identification, purification (shodhana), marana, and nanostructured characterization for Kasis Bhasma (calcined ferrous sulphate) used for iron deficiency anemia.
new_standard.materials: Purified green vitriol (Kasisa - FeSO4.7H2O) incinerated with herbal juices.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total iron content (min 50.0% Fe), ferrous/ferric iron ratio, Varitaratva test (floats on water), Rekhapurnatva test (enters skin furrows), acid insoluble ash (max 5.0%), absence of free sulfur.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Traditional nanostructured Bhasma properties ensuring rapid biological assimilation without gastrointestinal irritation.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Chemical assay for iron per API Annex, traditional organoleptic tests (Varitaratva, Apunarbhava).

new_standard.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India — Formulations: Kumkumadi Taila Monograph
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for classical Kumkumadi Taila medicated facial oil prepared with saffron (Crocus sativus), sandalwood, and goat milk in sesame oil base per Bhaishajya Ratnavali.
new_standard.materials: Saffron stigmata, Sandalwood (Chandan), Manjistha, Yashtimadhu, goat milk, sesame oil.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Refractive index at 40°C (1.465 to 1.472), weight per ml (0.915 to 0.930 g), saponification value (185 to 205), acid value (max 3.5), TLC profile showing saffron crocin/crocetin spots.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Bright golden-red viscous oil with distinct saffron aroma; zero synthetic colouring or mineral oils.
new_standard.testing_requirements: TLC fingerprinting per API Annex, acid value per IS 548, heavy metals limits.

Panchakarma Shirodhara Brass Vessels.investigation_notes: Shirodhara pots/vessels are traditional artisan-crafted copper/brass Panchakarma hardware utensils fabricated with diverse hanging chains, control stopcocks, and customized oil orifices (1 to 3 mm). They are classified as hospital/clinic clinicware equipment rather than standardized pharmaceutical items; no dedicated BIS technical committee specification currently standardizes their exact dimensions, requiring procurement clarification on mechanical specs.

new_standard.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India — Minerals and Metals: Shankha and Shankha Bhasma
new_standard.scope: Specifies identification, shodhana and calcinative marana for Shankha Bhasma (calcined conch shell - calcium carbonate/oxide nanostructured powder) for hyperacidity and gastrointestinal disorders.
new_standard.materials: Purified shells of marine mollusc Turbinella pyrum L. calcined with aloe vera / lemon juice.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Calcium content as CaCO3 (min 85.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 2.0%), fineness (enters skin furrows Rekhapurna), loss on ignition (max 5.0%), heavy metals limits.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Pure white micro-fine powder, antacid bio-availability, free from grit or un-calcined shell particles.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Calcium assay by EDTA titrimetry, Varitaratva test, ICP-MS heavy metals per API Annex.

new_standard.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India: Shilajatu (Shodhita) Monograph
new_standard.scope: Specifies identity, traditional water-purification (shodhana) and purity criteria for purified Asphaltum / Shilajit resin.
new_standard.materials: Natural purified bituminous mineral-herbal exudate from Himalayan rock strata.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Fulvic acid content (min 30.0% to 50.0%), humic acid, water soluble extractive (min 80.0%), total ash (max 15.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 2.0%), lead (max 10 ppm), arsenic (max 3 ppm), mercury (max 1 ppm).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Characteristic bitumen/cow-urine aroma, dissolves completely in warm water without leaving sandy residue, high antioxidant potency.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Fulvic acid assay by UV/titrimetry, heavy metals by ICP-MS per API, water soluble extractive per IS 1797.

new_standard.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India — Formulations: Triphala Churna Monograph
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements for classical Triphala Churna prepared by pulverizing equal parts of dried pericarp of Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), and Amalaki (Emblica officinalis).
new_standard.materials: Clean dried fruit rind of three myrobalans in 1:1:1 proportion.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total ash (max 8.0%), acid insoluble ash (max 1.5%), alcohol soluble extractive (min 35.0%), water soluble extractive (min 40.0%), tannin content (min 20.0%), particle fineness (passes 180-micron sieve).
new_standard.performance_requirements: Astringent taste with sweet aftertaste; zero mold, insects, or synthetic additive contamination.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Tannin estimation by titrimetry per API Annex, microscopic identification of three fruit tissues.

new_standard.title: The Unani Pharmacopoeia of India — Formulations: Roghan-e-Badam Shireen Monograph
new_standard.scope: Specifies identity, purity and strength for classical Unani Roghan-e-Badam Shireen (cold-pressed sweet almond oil formulation per Bayaz-e-Kabeer).
new_standard.materials: 100% pure cold-expressed oil of sweet almond kernels (Prunus amygdalus Batsch).
new_standard.technical_requirements: Refractive index at 40°C (1.462 to 1.465), specific gravity at 25°C (0.910 to 0.920), saponification value (190 to 200), iodine value (95 to 105), acid value (max 2.0), heavy metals limits.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Clear pale yellow oil with sweet nutty aroma; zero adulteration with mineral oil, apricot kernel oil, or cottonseed oil.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Fatty acid profile by GC per UPI Annex, Baudouin test, Bieber test for peach/apricot kernel oil.
